name: stuck_work_monitor_20261031
comment: ANCHOR: STUCK_WORK_MONITOR_20261031 — stuck-work monitor (operator 2026-10-31). Pins every detection class with a
positive control (self-deadlock, lock wait, D state, unit activating/failed, truncated JSONL tail, zero-byte state,
stalled queue and unknown-not-zero, open breaker, stale heartbeat, silent lane, unit on an old release), the safe
heals (archive first, final line only, allowlisted restarts, never portfolio-server or broker units), one alert per
item per day, switches default off, and the N8nCodeDefect@v1 hand-off to the Claude Code fixer. Hermetic.
